source.waller_definition: (1) to be finished,to be ready,by definition,(2) to be very drunk

rows.mappingNote: New intransitive completion/readiness and colloquial drunkenness article, 1340610:1-2.
rows.sourceNote: Do not teach raw 'by definition' as a general adverb. Actual public body separately records inherent constitution, which is absent from the pinned two-sense family; do not falsely deny a dictionary basis. Related 出来上がり remains a noun, but real completion/result overlap is checked.

rows.mappingNote: New 的確 てきかく accuracy/aptitude article, same complete family 1437290:1 as the following 適確 source row.
rows.sourceNote: Both spellings and alternative てっかく are explicitly recognized. Priority/order does not establish relative frequency; source spelling 的 remains in primary metadata although its kanji card is absent.

rows.mappingNote: Map 適確 to explicit same-family variant recognition in 的確, 1437290:1; no duplicate article.
rows.sourceNote: The source spelling and てきかく reading are taught explicitly; substantive 適 link accompanies the variant explanation. Do not invent a separate meaning or reading restriction.

rows.mappingNote: New wrist article, 手首 てくび 1327770:1.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish the wrist from hand, arm and neck. Rare 手頸 and search-only 手頚 are recognition information, not ordinary example recommendations.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse stable kana-only でこぼこ article with explicit 凸凹 recognition and sourced N2, 1582410:1.
rows.sourceNote: Physical unevenness is the source anchor. Existing imbalance sense2 remains restricted to でこぼこ; とつおう and obsolete だくぼく do not inherit it. Reversed 凹凸 is not mechanically substituted into the compound examples.
rows.identityNote: Preserve primary でこぼこ ID/reading/title/type/kanji/tags and all existing exclusions; old level absent.

rows.mappingNote: New handy/convenient and suitable/moderate article, 手頃 てごろ 1327660:1-2.
rows.sourceNote: Also teach 手ごろ. Handy size/handling and appropriate means or price are distinct applications; a suitable price is not necessarily the cheapest. Do not propagate every English 'reasonable' relation.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary nonsense/haphazard article, 1339630:1-2, with ateji 出鱈目 recognition.
rows.sourceNote: Keep primary kana metadata empty. The character meanings are not a literal etymological definition; everyday haphazard unreliability is not a statistical randomness lesson. English 'rubbish' does not establish a garbage-word guard.

rows.mappingNote: New pocket notebook/diary article, 手帳 てちょう 1598330:1.
rows.sourceNote: Mixed native 手て plus on 帳チョウ, using verified native-first wago precedents 荷物 and 豚肉, not an all-on claim. Official-document abbreviations are bounded by complete cross-reference families 2530640 and 1830990.

rows.mappingNote: New iron/steel or railway-bridge article, 鉄橋 てっきょう 1437820:1.
rows.sourceNote: Public mixed heading separately refers to 鉄灸 てっきゅう, a grilling implement; do not transfer that use into the bridge family. Not every railway bridge must be iron. Add 鉄 and 橋 reciprocity on both reading and Common words surfaces.

rows.mappingNote: New procedure/formalities article, 手続き てつづき 1598350:1; recognize 手続.
rows.sourceNote: Explain safe 手続きをする rather than infer a universal direct-する prohibition from the pinned noun label. Procedures are not all operations or arbitrary event sequences.

rows.mappingNote: New firearm article, 鉄砲 てっぽう 1438010:1.
rows.sourceNote: Rare 鉄炮 remains qualified. Compound テツ/ホウ sound changes do not create basic テッ/ポウ readings. 銃 is a direct gun comparison; 武器 is broader rather than a free synonym. Add 鉄 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New tennis-court article, kana-only テニスコート 1080030:1.
rows.sourceNote: Recognize テニス・コート. Existing コート actually teaches the sports-court sense as well as coat, so it needs a guard; テニス names the sport rather than the playing area.

rows.mappingNote: New thin cotton towel article, 手拭い てぬぐい 1598400:1; recognize 手ぬぐい and 手拭.
rows.sourceNote: Selected modern てぬぐい derives its wiping part from ぬぐう, not ふく. Historical public headings are separated rather than promoted as modern practice. Cotton/thin are usual material/form descriptions, not every cloth or wiping implement.

rows.mappingNote: New near-side/before-a-location and social-position article, 手前 てまえ 1328030:1-3, with bounded marked-pronoun recognition6-7.
rows.sourceNote: Do not teach raw 'we' as a neutral plural pronoun. Explain actual humble first person and male-to-inferior second person with register boundaries; separate the public てめえ heading. Social face does not automatically establish physical 顔 equivalence.

rows.mappingNote: New noun for going out to meet/receive an arrival, 出迎え でむかえ 1338710:1.
rows.sourceNote: Public body also records the person doing the meeting. Teach 出迎えに行く/出迎えをする without an unsupported absolute verbalization ban. Actual arrival reception differs from a clerical desk or a homecoming utterance.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive ichidan article for going out to greet/receive an arrival, 1338720:1.
rows.sourceNote: Whole construction gives personを and meeting placeに/で. Going to an entrance suffices; not every scheduled discussion or chance encounter is an arrival reception. Nominal/verb overlap is assessed directly, not exempted by POS.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse stable 照らす てらす with sourced N2 and linked 照る comparison, 1350840:1.
rows.sourceNote: Existing body already teaches the source illumination sense and separate standard/reference construction. Existing 照 reciprocates 照らす at both required surfaces; preserve them while adding 照る.
rows.identityNote: Preserve primary ID/reading/title/type/kanji/tags and the complete existing eight-word exclusion list; old level absent.

rows.mappingNote: New intransitive godan shining article, 照る てる 1350860:1; actual public body also supports sunny-weather use.
rows.sourceNote: Explain 照ります/照って, not ichidan forms. Specialized mask orientation is not every upward gaze. Read actual sunlight secondary senses of 射す/差す and sunny 晴れる rather than title-only comparisons. Add 照 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New unfolding/development/expansion article with bounded computing extraction, 展開 てんかい 1440600:1-2,5.
rows.sourceNote: Development need not be improvement. Compression is a contrast only for the computing sense; actual separately captured 解凍 sense2 resolves the public cross-reference. Complete family supports both transitive and intransitive uses, with business sense6 transitive.

rows.mappingNote: New biography/life-story article, 伝記 でんき 1441960:1.
rows.sourceNote: Separate public でんき biography from unrelated しるしぶみ heading. A biography is not necessarily fiction or every historical record; 電気 is an unrelated homophone, not an alias or a guard justified by pronunciation.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive author hypotheses, not independent findings. Compare actual titles and complete ordinary senses for excesses/omissions, not topic matches, neighbor inheritance or blanket noun/verb exemptions.

Completion/readiness and drunkenness need actual secondary-sense checks. Accuracy/aptitude differs from certainty alone; suitable/handy/moderate price does not inherit every English 'reasonable' relation.

Nonsense/haphazard usage is not literal garbage or statistical randomness. Notebook/diary overlap differs from an individual note. Gun is narrower than weapon, but the broad physical label may still be defensible.
Existing コート genuinely teaches sports court. Towel and cloth comparisons concern actual objects; handkerchief/cleaning-cloth shared functions do not alone establish equivalence.
手前 requires actual spatial, standpoint and marked pronoun checks. Figurative social face is not automatically physical 顔; separate てめえ is not imported.
Arrival nouns/verbs and generic welcome/meeting labels receive direct checks; clerical reception and homecoming utterances are not automatically the same lexical meaning.
Shining and sunny weather require actual ordinary light senses, including 差す beyond its umbrella title. Expansion/development need not improve; biography is not fiction or the homophone 電気.
Unchanged reused exclusions are preserved, not claimed as newly designed. Missing neighboring cards are not invented.
